The '''Gladean State Parks Fund''' was a tax-supported fund that supported the [[Gladean State Parks]]. [[Crystal Canyons]] and the [[Hanna Wild Game Reserve]] both received a majority of their funding from the Fund.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
